Thanks again for the demo today  the team was impressed with the latency profile and the prefix caching behavior. Two quick follow-ups from our side: 

1) Can you send an updated pricing worksheet that shows committed-use tiers? We're trying to model cost per 1M tokens across different commitment sizes.
2) We are an early-stage startup (Series A) and would like to understand if you have a startup program/credit, or any multi-year incentives for committed usage.

Rough usage expectation: initial pilot 1-2M tokens/month (NLP reranking + chat), with a goal of scaling to ~10M tokens/month within 9-12 months if results look good. Our procurement lead (Priya) is on copy - she will need committed-use paperwork and any contract term guidance.

Appreciate a short recap and proposed options so we can present to leadership.

- Alex
Head of Product, Finexa

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@finexa.com>, Priya Shah <priya@finexa.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo recap + next steps

Thanks Alex - great conversation. Quick recap and three proposed options below. Attached: redwood_pricing_v3.xlsx (detailed slab pricing + committed-use examples) and a draft of startup_terms_draft.docx that lists typical credits.

Recap / assumptions from call:
- Pilot: 1-2M tokens/month for 3 months (reranking + chat).
- Scale target: ~10M tokens/month within 9-12 months.
- Target unit economics: you asked about target $/1M tokens - we heard ~$600-800/1M as the budget range.

Proposed options (high level):
A) Startup program (no long-term commitment)
  - 3 months of 50% credit up to $10k in usage credits (applies to hosted API usage).
  - Standard pay-as-you-go rates after credits - sheet shows baseline $1,200/1M tokens for the selected model family.

B) 12-month committed-use (recommended for predictable unit economics)
  - Commit to a 12-month committed spend that nets ~4M tokens/month committed (initial), ramp to 10M by month 9.
  - Committed price example: $500/1M tokens effective with a 12-month commit at our public model family (volume-weighted).
  - Startup incentive: first 3 months 20% additional credit on top of committed discount.

C) 36-month multi-year (best unit economics for larger, longer-term customers)
  - 36-month committed profile with annual purchase tiers.
  - Example effective price: $420/1M tokens (requires fiscal/contract review).

Next steps I recommend:
1) Ben to confirm approval range for the three options and any guardrails we should apply (e.g., minimum committed $/month).
2) Priya to confirm procurement timeline and whether Finexa needs any specific legal language (SLA, data residency, audit logs).
3) I will share the updated pricing sheet (attached) and a short one-pager that maps expected monthly spend to effective $/1M tokens for each commitment level.

Happy to hop on a quick call with procurement and finance this week if helpful.

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Follow-up: Pricing and committed-use options - Finexa

Alex / Priya - adding a couple of concrete numbers to Marissa's summary to speed modeling on your side.

Assumptions for the worked examples in the attached sheet:
- Model family: rdx-2-small (production-quality for rerank + chat).
- Baseline public rate (no commit): $1,200 / 1M tokens.

Committed examples (effective $/1M after commit):
- 3M tokens/month commit (12mo): ~$700 / 1M tokens
- 6M tokens/month commit (12mo): ~$550 / 1M tokens
- 10M tokens/month commit (12mo): ~$500 / 1M tokens

Multi-year (36mo) example: 10M tokens/month committed -> ~$420 / 1M tokens (includes additional multi-year uplift).

Notes: These figures assume hosted deployment and do not include optional dedicated/reserved capacity charges. If you need an SLA-backed Dedicated lane we can separate reserved capacity pricing (+ fixed monthly).

Ben
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa and Ben - this is helpful and close to what we were hoping to see. A couple points from our side: 

- Pilot commitment: we can start with a 3-month pilot at ~1.5M tokens/month. If the pilot meets performance and cost expectations, we are prepared to sign a 12-month committed-use agreement that targets ~6M tokens/month average over the year (with planned ramp).
- Target unit economics: leadership is comfortable modeling to ~$600/1M tokens as a stretch target, and would prefer to see a 12-month committed option in the $500-550/1M range. That aligns with Ben's numbers above.
- Startup program: the 3-month credit + startup terms look good; Priya will validate procurement/legal requirements.

Next steps for us:
1) Priya: confirm procurement timeline and any PO/contract template needs.
2) Marissa/Ben: please share a 12-month committed proposal (6M avg) with line items and a sample SOW or MSA redline expectation so procurement can start review.
3) Set a 30-minute procurement + finance sync next week to align on terms.

If you can get the committed-use proposal and the MSA redline link by EOD Tuesday (2026-12-08), we'll slot time into Priya's calendar.

- Alex
